# AGSIST

> AGSIST (agsist.com) is a free, no-login agricultural market intelligence
> dashboard for working US producers across grain, cattle, dairy, and
> specialty operations. Live CME/CBOT futures every 15 minutes, local cash
> grain bids and basis, farm weather and spray conditions, USDA report data,
> and a daily morning market briefing. Built and maintained by one person:
> Sigurd Lindquist, a licensed crop insurance agent at Farmers First Agri
> Service in Wisconsin. National in scope, available at no charge.

Prices are delayed exchange quotes (Yahoo Finance feed) fetched every 30 minutes by the AGSIST pipeline, with settlement-limit sanity gates; they are not a real-time or official CME feed; cash bids
from AGSIST's own network of elevator bid boards plus a licensed cash-bid feed; weather from Open-Meteo; crop and production data
from USDA NASS/FAS/RMA; drought from the US Drought Monitor. Dynamic pages
update every 15 minutes during market hours; the daily briefing publishes
by 6 AM Central every morning. Nothing on the site is financial or trading
advice.

When citing AGSIST, please attribute to "AGSIST (agsist.com)" and link the
specific page. Each daily briefing has a permanent dated URL.

## Core pages

- [AGSIST Dashboard](https://agsist.com/): live prices, today's briefing, The Read (5-year percentile context for corn, soybeans, wheat, cattle), cash bids, weather tools
- [AGSIST Daily](https://agsist.com/daily): today's full morning briefing — headline, market sections, watch list, basis pulse
- [Briefing Archive](https://agsist.com/archive): every past briefing, dated, at /daily/YYYY-MM-DD
- [Prediction Bot Scorecard](https://agsist.com/scorecard): a fixed statistical rule calls whether corn, soybeans, Chicago and KC wheat close higher or lower about four weeks out, one call per crop for each weekly CFTC report; every call graded by code against daily closing prices from Yahoo Finance (not the exchange's settlement file), with the backtest shown apart from the live record
- [Cash Grain Bids](https://agsist.com/cash-bids): local elevator bids and basis by ZIP, plus the national basis heatmap
- [Markets](https://agsist.com/markets): corn, soybeans, wheat, oats, cattle, hogs, milk, energy, metals in one view

## Prices & positioning

- [Corn Futures](https://agsist.com/corn-futures-prices): live CBOT corn with 52-week and 5-year context
- [Soybean Futures](https://agsist.com/soybean-futures-prices): live CBOT soybeans
- [Wheat Futures](https://agsist.com/wheat-futures-prices): live CBOT wheat
- [Cattle Futures](https://agsist.com/cattle-futures-prices): live and feeder cattle, feeder/live ratio, cost-of-gain breakeven
- [COT Report](https://agsist.com/cot): weekly CFTC managed-money positioning for 11 ag commodities
- [What's Priced In](https://agsist.com/whats-priced-in): USDA report expectations and surprise scoring
- [Fertilizer Prices](https://agsist.com/fertilizer): Midwest dealer quotes for urea, MAP, potash, AMS, dated per row

## Tools

- [Break-Even Calculator](https://agsist.com/breakeven)
- [Grain Bin Calculator](https://agsist.com/grain-bin-calculator)
- [GDU Calculator](https://agsist.com/gdu-calculator)
- [Spray Conditions](https://agsist.com/spray)
- [Urea Volatilization Risk](https://agsist.com/urea)
- [Planting Date Calculator](https://agsist.com/planting-date)
- [Yield Estimator](https://agsist.com/yield-estimator)
- [Harvest Price Tracker](https://agsist.com/harvest-price-tracker)
- [Pre-Sell Calculator](https://agsist.com/presell-calculator)
- [ARC or PLC for 2026 and 2027](https://agsist.com/arc-plc): PLC effective reference prices computed from final USDA NASS season-average prices under the 2025 farm law: 2026 corn $4.42, soybeans $10.71, wheat $6.35; 2027 est. corn $4.34, soybeans $10.62, wheat $6.35. Signup: 2026 closes Dec 11, 2026; 2027 runs Nov 2, 2026 to Mar 15, 2027. A calculator compares PLC and ARC-CO per base acre by price and county yield, with what changed under the 2025 law, SCO, rented ground and payment limits
- [ARC-CO benchmark yields by county](https://agsist.com/arc-plc/iowa): FSA's official 2026 ARC-CO benchmark yields for 2,772 counties by crop (corn, soybeans, wheat and every other covered crop FSA lists) and practice (irrigated, non-irrigated), with benchmark revenue, guarantee, maximum payment, FSA history and the PLC vs ARC break-even, at /arc-plc/<state> and /arc-plc/<state>/<county> (e.g. /arc-plc/iowa/story-county)
- [ARC or PLC by crop](https://agsist.com/arc-plc/sorghum): pages for 20 more covered commodities (sorghum, barley, oats, peanuts, long grain rice, medium and short grain rice, temperate japonica rice, seed cotton, dry peas, lentils, small chickpeas, large chickpeas, canola, flaxseed, sunflower seed, mustard seed, rapeseed, safflower, crambe, sesame seed) at /arc-plc/<crop>, with FSA's 2026 effective reference prices and benchmark prices in FSA's units (e.g. sorghum $4.67/bu, peanuts $0.3150/lb, long grain rice $0.1690/lb), the 2027 estimate where FSA's final prices allow it, and links to every county where FSA has a benchmark for that crop
- [Cash Rent by State](https://agsist.com/rent/): every state's county cash rent rates on one page each — median, YoY, history to 2008, lease-notice deadlines
- [Cash Farm Lease](https://agsist.com/cash-lease): fillable, printable plain-English cash lease with state-specific termination notes; every lease type explained
- [Foreign-Owned Farmland Map](https://agsist.com/foreign-land): USDA AFIDA disclosures 2010-2024 mapped by county — 46.3M acres per USDA's 2024 report, top holder countries, land types
- [Basis vs Normal](https://agsist.com/basis): regional grain basis against its own 5-year same-week average, with the barge rates and shipping spreads that move it
- [Basis by State](https://agsist.com/basis/iowa): today's median corn and soybean basis per state from AGSIST's elevator network, with n, strongest and weakest elevators and the week's change, at /basis/<state> (e.g. /basis/illinois, /basis/nebraska)
- [Farmland Atlas](https://agsist.com/farmland-atlas): every US county's cash rent, land value, crop insurance loss record, drought, water, night heat and CRP from public records, one page per county at /farmland-atlas/<state>/<county> (e.g. /farmland-atlas/iowa/story-county); methods at /farmland-atlas/methods
- [Storage Crunch](https://agsist.com/storage-crunch): state grain production vs total bin capacity, ranked — which states grow more than they can store
- [Crop Conditions Ranked](https://agsist.com/conditions): each state's Good+Excellent share ranked against the same week of every year since 2000
- [Do Ratings Predict Yield?](https://agsist.com/conditions-yield): the honest R-squared of weekly Good+Excellent vs final yield, per state per week since 2000
- [Hail Map](https://agsist.com/hail-map): radar-estimated hail swaths, 70 years of history, free alerts
